title: TV Series Detail Page - Seasons & Episodes
completion_summary: Implemented TV series detail page with seasons/episodes. Created 4 files: page.tsx (server), TvDetail.tsx (hero+metadata+sidebar), SeasonList.tsx (accordion), EpisodeList.tsx (compact cards). Added 22 i18n keys in en/th.
acceptance_criteria: TV detail page shows: name, original_name, tagline, overview
Shows: seasons list with poster, episode_count, air_date
Season expandable to show episode list with: air_date, episode_number, name, overview, still_path, vote_average
All text uses i18n translation keys
